item.description: The impact of the last Netball World Cup on Australian soil is still being felt today. Now, 2027 organisers are aiming to break that tournament's world-record crowd again in Sydney.

item.title: ABC News: Aloisi sacked from Chinese club after losing final five games in title choke
item.description: John Aloisi has paid the price for Chengdu Rongcheng's catastrophic title choke, with the Chinese club sacking the Socceroos great.

item.title: ABC News: Major change proposed for Ipswich City Council
item.description: How many local councillors is too many? Residents in a south-east Queensland council where each division has two councillors want a return to having just one to deal with.

item.title: ABC News: Cricket Australia will not have another Sandpapergate investigation
item.description: Cricket Australia will not reopen an investigation into the infamous 2018 Sandpapergate controversy, according to chief executive Todd Greenberg, in the wake of Usman Khawaja's claims that the entire Australian Test team knew it was happening.

item.title: ABC News: Study links heart issues to starting and stopping Ozempic-like drugs
item.description: A large study suggests people with type 2 diabetes who start and then stop GLP-1 drugs may have poorer health outcomes, but more research is needed.

item.title: ABC News: Live: Beau Lamarre-Condon faces grilling in cross-examination
item.description: Beau Lamarre-Condon is back being cross-examined by the prosecution in his double murder trial.

item.title: ABC News: Police hopeful of finding teen missing in dense bushland since Friday
item.description: William, whose surname has not been released by authorities, was camping with a friend at Walhalla East, near Cowwarr in Gippsland, when he disappeared on Friday.

item.title: ABC News: Live: Victorian leaders ramp up election campaigns as royal commission continues
item.description: As Labor and the Liberals continue their campaign push, One Nation has spoken with the ABC and the Greens have announced a new policy modelled on one launched in New York City.

item.title: ABC News: Defence site in Darwin's suburbs pitched as location of potential new hospital
item.description: The Northern Territory Labor Opposition says it will build a new Royal Darwin Hospital if it wins the 2028 NT election.

item.title: ABC News: Animal welfare campaigner dobbed into council for having five rescue cats
item.description: Lisa Roberts-Daintree receives a compliance notice from Redland City Council after a neighbour reported her for exceeding Redland's two-cat maximum rule.

item.title: ABC News: Breaking: 81-year-old sci-fi writer becomes oldest-ever winner of $95k Booker Prize
item.description: M John Harrison has won the Booker Prize for The End of Everything, which the judges described as "the politics of now seen through the lens of the future".

item.title: ABC News: Acute mental health patients waiting up to six days in hospital's ED
item.description: One doctor described the situation as unprecedented, immoral and potentially dangerous.

item.title: ABC News: The elusive desert frogs scientists want Central Australians to find
item.description: Some desert frogs can spend years underground, emerging only after rain. Now scientists are asking Central Australians to help track them down.
